note: Manistee NF rustic campground on Minnie Pond, a human-made impoundment on Mena Creek frequented by ducks, geese and herons; popular for small- and large-game and waterfowl hunting. About 10-11 sites and a boat launch. A footbridge over Mena Creek links the campground to the day-use area. No ORVs in the campground or on its access road. --Claude
summary: FS page (updated 2026-05-14): $10 single site (confirmed), Senior/Access 50% off (new), all sites first-come (confirmed; no recreation.gov listing), season year-round, not maintained Nov 1 - Apr 30 (new), vault toilets and no potable water (confirmed).
